name: billbuddy
description: BillBuddy - offline legal time tracking, billing, and trust accounting software

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:server
